entries.title: An analysis technique to increase testability of object-oriented components
entries.key_innovation: Analyzes Java component bytecode to build control/data flow graphs and increase component testability by improving controllability and observability.

entries.title: A software testing assessment to manage project testability
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a software testing assessment approach for evaluating and managing project testability during the development lifecycle.

entries.title: A preliminary testability model for object-oriented software
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a preliminary framework evaluating object-oriented software testability metrics, identifying design factors that affect fault revealing probability.

entries.title: A component testability model for verification and measurement
entries.key_innovation: Introduces a quantifiable component testability analysis model enabling verification and measurement of component testability throughout component development.

entries.title: An in-depth investigation into the relationships between structural metrics and unit testability in object-oriented systems
entries.key_innovation: Empirically investigates relationships between object-oriented structural metrics and unit testability to identify predictors and improve testability assessment.

entries.title: Practicing testability in the real world
entries.key_innovation: Provides practical guidelines and real-world examples for incorporating testability considerations into feature planning and design.

entries.title: Design for testability in object-oriented systems
entries.key_innovation: Maps the testability terrain for object-oriented development, identifying techniques and paths to reveal software faults more easily and cheaply.

entries.title: Using indirect coupling metrics to predict package maintainability and testability
entries.key_innovation: Uses indirect coupling metrics to predict package maintainability and testability, providing empirical prediction models for software quality.

entries.title: Mutation-driven generation of unit tests and oracles
entries.key_innovation: Mutation-driven test generation that uses state-change-induced oracles to produce unit tests optimized for detecting seeded defects.

entries.title: Automated unit test generation during software development
entries.key_innovation: Empirically evaluates automated unit test generation during development, showing EvoSuite increases branch coverage and reduces testing time versus manual unit testing.

entries.title: Automated test case generation as a many-objective optimisation problem with dynamic selection of the targets
entries.key_innovation: Introduces DynaMOSA, a many-objective search algorithm with dynamic selection of coverage targets for scalable automated test case generation.

entries.title: Improving search-based test suite generation with dynamic symbolic execution
entries.key_innovation: Adaptive hybrid test generation that integrates dynamic symbolic execution into EvoSuite's genetic algorithm, with search feedback determining when DSE is suitable for difficult value generation.

entries.title: Does mutation testing´ improve testing practices?
entries.key_innovation: Empirical investigation of whether using mutation testing improves developers' testing practices, likely evaluating effects rather than proposing a new technique.

entries.title: State of mutation testing at google
entries.key_innovation: Diff-based probabilistic mutation analysis that drastically reduces mutants by omitting uncovered and uninteresting 'arid' lines to focus on relevant mutants.

entries.title: A theory of fault-based testing
entries.key_innovation: A formal theory of fault-based testing that uses symbolic execution to derive propagation equations differentiating a program from alternate faulty expressions.

entries.title: Constraint-based automatic test data generation
entries.key_innovation: Constraint-based automatic test data generation using mutation analysis and algebraic constraints, implemented in Godzilla to create test cases that kill mutants.

entries.title: Ripples of a mutation—an empirical study of propagation effects in mutation testing
entries.key_innovation: Empirical study of how mutation-induced faults propagate into test failures, analyzing mechanics from fault injection to observable failures to inform testing and repair.

entries.title: Strong higher order mutationbased test data generation
entries.key_innovation: Strong higher-order mutation-based test data generation approach targeting higher-order mutants to generate effective test data.

entries.title: Measuring software testability modulo test quality
entries.key_innovation: Testability measurement approach that incorporates test suite quality, rather than only size and complexity, to relate code characteristics to test effort.

entries.title: Measuring software testability via automatically generated test cases
entries.key_innovation: Testability estimation technique exploiting automatic test generation and mutation analysis to quantify evidence about the relative hardness of developing effective test cases.

entries.title: Improving evolutionary testing by flag removal
entries.key_innovation: Flag removal transformation that improves evolutionary testing by eliminating flag variables and smoothing the fitness landscape.

entries.title: Improving evolutionary testing in the presence of function-assigned flags
entries.key_innovation: Code transformation addressing function-assigned flags to improve the fitness landscape and provide better guidance for evolutionary structural testing.

entries.title: Evolutionary testing in the presence of loop-assigned flags
entries.key_innovation: Testability transformation for loop-assigned flags enabling evolutionary testing, with a second transformation reducing runtime and cost slope by an order of magnitude.

entries.title: Empirical evaluation of a nesting testability transformation for evolutionary testing
entries.key_innovation: Nesting testability transformation that evaluates all nested conditionals simultaneously, reducing search overfitting and improving evolutionary test data generation.

entries.title: Branch-coverage testability transformation for unstructured programs
entries.key_innovation: Branch-coverage testability transformation for unstructured programs that defines branch adequacy equivalence and proves preservation of branch coverage adequacy.

entries.title: Bytecode testability transformation
entries.key_innovation: Bytecode-level testability transformation approach to improve automated test data generation for programs with unstructured or difficult control flow.

entries.title: Automated refactoring for testability
entries.key_innovation: Automated refactoring guided by the LSCC cohesion metric to improve software testability, evaluated by comparing test-writing difficulty before and after refactoring.

entries.title: Search-based refactoring
entries.key_innovation: Empirical comparison of simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, and multiple ascent hill-climbing for automated search-based refactoring of object-oriented designs.

entries.title: An aspect-oriented testability framework
entries.key_innovation: Aspect-oriented testability framework improving observability through runtime constraint checking against implementations, helping detect design drift in object-oriented software.

entries.title: Improving the testability of object oriented software through software contracts
entries.key_innovation: Instruments method preconditions, postconditions, and class invariants as software contracts to reduce required test cases and improve object-oriented software testability.

entries.title: Investigating the use of analysis contracts to improve the testability of object-oriented code
entries.key_innovation: Instruments OCL analysis contracts such as preconditions, postconditions, and class invariants to ease test oracle definition and fault isolation, improving object-oriented code testability.

entries.title: Aop-based testability improvement for component-based software
entries.key_innovation: Uses aspect-oriented programming to embed self-checking aspects for invariant checking and tracing aspects for precondition collection, improving component testability and regression test selection.

entries.title: How to kill them all
entries.key_innovation: Investigates how testability and observability metrics, especially test directness, correlate with mutation scores to help developers reason about improving production code testability versus reinforcing tests.

entries.title: New York
entries.key_innovation: No technical contribution can be inferred from the title 'New York'.

entries.title: Strong higher order mutation-based test data generation
entries.key_innovation: SHOM combines dynamic symbolic execution with search-based software testing to generate test data that achieves strong mutation adequacy and kills first- and higher-order mutants.

entries.title: Random or evolutionary search for object‐oriented test suite generation?
entries.key_innovation: Empirically compares evolutionary search algorithms, including genetic algorithm and chemical reaction optimization, against random search for generating object-oriented unit test suites to assess structural code coverage benefits.
